evals.prompt: The party may hear about the Grandfather Hole in Kalowe. Make wiki/entities/lore/the-grandfather-hole.md something the DM can run if they go looking.
evals.expected_output: A lore page that answers the legend: which claims are true, distorted, or false and what is really there; where it is; who moves on it; stakes with numbers; accounts with holders; three-clue revelations; At the Table handles; proposals marked.

assertions.text: Working notes carry a canon inventory built from backlinks and search (Sawek, Kalowe, Midchain at least)

Current Truth answers every claim in the telling (freezing black water, a Sawek big enough to pull down a galleon, the wreck reef, scattered gold, animated drowned sailors) as true, distorted, or false, with what is really there
Every item the old page left open or unknown (location, Sawek identity and size, wreck condition, whether the dead are animated) has one concrete answer on the page; no Open Canon section remains
The location is concrete: a bearing and distance from Kalowe or a linked place
A named actor moves on the truth on their own clock, with a time
Stakes name what the party can win and lose with numbers (gold or item value, the creature's CR or statblock link, dive DCs, days)
Accounts give two to four in-world versions, each with its holder and how it is wrong usefully; the common telling is in a tavern voice
Each needed conclusion has three clues from different linked sources; uncertain clues carry Ability (Skill) and DC
At the Table fills notice, explains, enables, and warns
lifecycle and reveal stay proposed and unrevealed; no Canon Log; party knowledge comes from session notes
Fun: the truth carries a twist or payoff that rewards the party for investigating, beyond confirming the rumor
Invented facts are canon proposals: the-grandfather-hole.md carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from

Every page filed states each proposal as world fact in world voice; provenance, contradictions, and the proposal list live only in response.md (no 'this proposal', 'is not established', 'unknown', 'unresolved', 'the source' commentary on any page)

Every named person, creature, place, or faction the page depends on links an owner page; each new mint is filed under outputs at its owner path and response.md names the candidates considered and why none fit
Working notes (process.md or response.md) show a written Done audit: each Done item paired with the page line that satisfies it

evals.context: Search the wiki when a role, a rule the input pages point to, or the filing path needs it. Skip art and image review.

evals.prompt: Turn wiki/entities/lore/taking-on-aruhe.md into a clean lore page using wiki/templates/lore.md. The established rule is that fallen fruit is safe but taking living fruit (or other living claims) triggers predators. Ground everything in what the wiki already says — Session 11 confirmation, Matteo's death-rule stance, Western Landing usage. Do not invent a metaphysical cause. Wiki Linter marked hard_fail=false on taking-on-aruhe.md; still assert output template conformance (At a Glance / Current Truth / Limits / At the Table) even if the live page is pre-template shaped.
evals.expected_output: A lore page answering one durable question, with At a Glance (Core truth / Why it matters / Scope), Current Truth, Limits (Exception/Unknown/Impossible), and At the Table handles — preserving the fallen-vs-living split without inventing divine or fungal origins.

assertions.text: Durable question or identity framing appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Invented facts are canon proposals: the page carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from
Output uses wiki/templates/lore.md heading-form sections ## At a Glance, ## Current Truth, ## Limits, and ## At the Table with filled substance — callout-form At-a-Glance copy-forward alone fails
Current Truth and Limits are proper sections with runnable substance (Core rule + Exception/Impossible), not empty headings or stub callout paste
Frontmatter includes type: lore and kind/truth/summary fields
Core truth preserves fallen fruit safe vs taking living fruit/claims draws hostility
Keeps the established fallen-fruit and living-claim rule; any cause added is one concrete canon proposal grown from wiki pages
At the Table includes Players notice / This enables / This warns of handles that change a harvest choice
What the world has not tested (shaking a living tree) stays untested for people in the world, and Current Truth carries the DM answer as a proposal

evals.prompt: Explain why Aruhe's taking rule works. Is it a curse from an ancient god? A symbiotic fungal network? Give me the real answer and put it on wiki/entities/lore/taking-on-aruhe.md as Current Truth.
evals.expected_output: The skill states the observable rule and that the metaphysical cause is not established in the wiki. Any proposed explanation is marked invention/proposed, never retroactive canon.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented metaphysical explanation as established Current Truth or wiki fact
States what is known: the observable fallen-vs-living rule and witnessed effects
Decides the cause as one concrete canon proposal grown from wiki pages and states it as world fact on the DM page; the world's ignorance stays in Accounts or Who Knows
Any proposed explanation is clearly marked as invention/proposed, not silent canon
response.md lists the proposal with its grounding pages; no Open Canon section is left on the page

Frontmatter includes type: lore, kind, truth, and summary
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not vault canon
Does not claim a named vault harbour already uses this Pier-Debt Custom as established campaign fact
Answers one durable question; does not bundle unrelated encyclopedia truths
